_comment: Components Setup downloads from their official sources. Every file is checked against its SHA-256 before use; Setup refuses any entry whose sha256 is empty. Verified 2026-11-05.

postgresql._skip_note: skip entries are path prefixes: StackBuilder and its wxWidgets libraries are not needed

vc_runtime._comment: PostgreSQL's programs need the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (vcruntime140, vcruntime140_1, msvcp140), which its ZIP does not include. Instead of the system-wide installer (needs an administrator), Setup copies Microsoft-signed copies already downloaded above into PostgreSQL's own bin folder (app-local deployment): the vcruntime DLLs from the Python ZIP and msvcp140 from the pyarrow package (renamed there by delvewheel; content unchanged). Each copy must carry a valid Microsoft Authenticode signature.
